(2) A male host wearing a light blue denim jacket and black pants stands on a professional stage with vibrant pink and blue stage lighting. He gestures toward the audience, speaking enthusiastically into a microphone. Behind him, a large screen displays the university logo and event titles. (3) A musical group called 'Bestards' performs on stage; the lead singer has bright orange hair and wears a pink sweater with brown pants. They are surrounded by stage equipment like a drum set and guitars under blue spotlights and dynamic visual backgrounds. (4) A male singer, Qiu Fengze, walks through the aisles of a seated audience, smiling and high-fiving fans before returning to the main stage. The lighting shifts between warm interior glows and cool audience shadows. (5) A girl group named GENBLUE performs a synchronized dance routine on stage. They are dressed in trendy, dark-toned streetwear including crop tops and baggy jeans. A large LED screen behind them pulses with graphic patterns and the group's name. (6) The video concludes with the host reappearing in a close-up shot, speaking directly to the camera with a bright smile, while text overlays continue to appear at the bottom of the frame.

The acoustic environment has a slight indoor room resonance. (3) A mid-tempo pop-rock song (approx. 90 BPM) features a male vocalist with a clear, emotive timbre. He encourages audience participation as the music ducks slightly in volume, concluding the segment with a final swell of the electronic beat.
